recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not rename is-a for FHIR-5785, and do not revert the current descendant/self wording to the older exact phrase; the current text reflects the accepted resolution plus later approved refinements.
issue_request: FHIR-5785 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Vocabulary issue for ValueSet.compose.include.filter.op. The original request suggested renaming is-a to a descendant-style operator because not all code systems are subsumption-based, but the approved resolution kept is-a and clarified its definition as a transitive is-a relationship including the provided concept itself.

additional_context: Later Published/Persuasive issues FHIR-12065 and FHIR-16321 refined the same filter-operator wording to the current descendant/self parenthetical, and both are already represented on the combined branch. Source refactoring moved the built filter-operator source into source/valueset/codesystem-filter-operator.xml. ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini and ValueSet.compose.include.filter.op has a required binding to ValueSet/filter-operator.
